target_customer: Division 8 (doors, frames, hardware) distributors and estimators in construction
problem: Estimators manually read blueprints and specs to build door schedules and bids, which is slow and limits how many bids a team can submit.
business_model: B2B software for AI takeoffs and estimates

founders.name: Roop Pal
previous_startups: Founded two companies, names not listed
founders.background_notes: Worked on computer vision and machine learning per YC page.

founders.name: Puneet Sukhija
education: University of British Columbia, dropped out of computer science
previous_startups: Home building business, acquired when he was 23 per YC page
founders.background_notes: Built hundreds of houses over about seven years per YC page.

competitors.name: Procore (Esticom)
competitors.what: Construction management with estimating and takeoff via Esticom acquisition

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading varied construction drawings and specs reliably needs computer vision and language models, and the founders had Google and Waymo experience.

defensibility.rationale: Narrow focus on Division 8 with ERP exports and manufacturer cross-references can create workflow lock-in, though general takeoff tools could add the trade.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copying or acquisition found through 2026.

market_need_then: Estimators were capacity constrained. Company reports clients bidding 40 to 60 percent more with the same staff, which is a claim.

branding.domain_note: Uses bild.ai, with a d8.bild.ai subdomain for the Division 8 product.
branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN and Product Hunt launch in early 2025. Name shares with unrelated Bild apps and the German word for picture.

brand_strength.rationale: Launched with HN and Product Hunt coverage but no wider brand press, and the name is confused with other Bild products.

pivots.from: General blueprint reading for flooring, framing and door suppliers
pivots.to: Division 8 doors, frames and hardware takeoffs
pivots.why: Not stated, narrowed focus visible on current site.

outcome_analysis: Bild AI raised a 3.1 million dollar seed from Khosla Ventures in July 2025 and narrowed to Division 8 takeoffs where its site lists about 18 distributor customers. Technical founders plus a construction founder fit the problem, and a focused wedge helps against broader takeoff tools.
notes: Round confirmed by Business Insider and ProptechBuzz and several aggregators. VCBacked lists only 500K pre-seed and Simplify lists 3.2M total, unverified. Competitor dates are earlier than batch (Togal 2021, Esticom 2020) and are still active entrants as of founding. Confidence is high per the three dimensions but Series A not checked as none reported.
